column1: # Assertions for the smoke test. Only well-established biology is asserted;
# anything uncertain is left out and merely reported, so a failure means a real
# disagreement rather than a shaky expectation.
# kind:  gate   -> branch-gate label, expected yes / no / na (na = NOT ASSESSABLE)
#        marker -> diagnostic marker line, expected yes / no
#        hint   -> substring that must appear in the acetoclastic genus hint
# RESOLVED by wiring GTDB-Tk taxonomy into the gate (was xfail).
# hydrogenotroph, but it carries ACDS/CODH (cdhA/cdhC/cdhE) plus acs for
# AUTOTROPHIC carbon fixation and acetate assimilation. ACDS is reversible, so
# gene content cannot tell acetyl-CoA cleavage (acetoclastic) from acetyl-CoA
# synthesis (autotrophic). Taxonomy resolves it: o__Methanobacteriales is not
# an acetoclastic clade, so the gate is now scored absent on lineage.
# bcd and crt have no NCBIfam model, so this gate must report NOT ASSESSABLE
# even in a genome that genuinely performs the pathway. That is the honest
# answer and this asserts we keep giving it.
# Specificity control. E. coli carries pta, ackA, folD, atoB and the full eut
# operon, so it exercises nearly every symbol collision fixed on this branch
# Any methanogenesis gate firing here is a live bug.
